scoring_justification: The headline quantities are numeric values determined by DFT; full recompute from raw DFT data is infeasible in the verifier environment. The checker compares agent-reported values to paper-reported references with tolerances (absolute/relative) and additionally verifies structural consistency: bond lengths parsed from CIF within 3% of paper, mechanical stability via Born criteria on elastic constants, and G/B ratio derived from moduli. Thus the scoring is structural, not a pure recompute.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden reference values for bond lengths and material properties taken from the paper's Table 1 and text.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1 (elastic constants, moduli) and paper text (bond lengths, energy density, metallicity).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact values reported in the paper; they serve as the hidden gold for comparison.

schema.description: CIF file; the checker parses it and computes N–N, B–N1, and B–N2 bond lengths from the fractional coordinates and unit cell, comparing them to hidden paper-reported values within a tolerance.

outputs.description: Relaxed crystal structure of t‑B₂N₃. Bond lengths are checked against the paper's reported values (N–N 1.33 Å, B–N1 1.53 Å, B–N2 1.59 Å) with a 3 % tolerance.

Computed properties of t‑B₂N₃. Numeric values are compared to hidden paper-reported references with tolerances; is_metallic must be true and band_gap_eV ≤ 0.1 eV. The G₀/B₀ ratio is used as an empirical indicator of superhardness.

output_contract.notes: The agent must use the PBE functional and public pseudopotentials. Any open-source DFT code that provides comparable accuracy is acceptable. The provided initial POSCAR must be used as the starting geometry. All calculations are at 0 GPa.

steps.description: Check N-N, B-N1, B-N2 bond lengths from CIF against paper values within 3%.
Check numeric properties against paper-reported values with specified tolerances.
